name: Kyoto, Japan
description: The cultural sanctuary of Japan, where centuries-old wooden machiya houses line cobblestone alleys, moss gardens breathe quietly in morning mist, and traditional tea ceremonies offer a refuge from the modern rush.
bestTimeToVisit: March to May (Sakura) or October to November (Autumn foliage)
highlights: Dawn walk through the silent Arashiyama bamboo grove
Matcha ceremony at a 400-year-old Daitoku-ji subtemple
Hidden ceramic studios in eastern Higashiyama
